stemMd: A cube has total surface area 150 square units. What is its volume?
explanationMd: Six faces each have area s squared, so 6s squared=150 and s=5. The volume is s cubed=125.

distractorRationale.c: This is the area of one face, not volume.
distractorRationale.e: This does not derive the side from six equal faces.
distractorRationale.b: Surface area and volume have different dimensions.
distractorRationale.d: This raises the side to the fourth rather than third power.
